jobs.description_text: Get to Know the Team The GrabFood Analytics team is part of ACE Analytics, which covers GrabFood, GrabMart, GrabExpress and OmniCommerce. We are the product analytics partners to the GrabFood product organisation across six Southeast Asian markets. Each analyst owns one or two product problem spaces end-to-end. They define the metrics that matter, design and read the experiments behind every launch, and run the deep dives that decide what gets built next. We work AI-first: analysts build and share reusable AI workflows that take on the repetitive parts of the job, so our time goes to judgement and product thinking. This is a new seat, created to take on additional product problem spaces. Get to Know the Role Reporting to the Senior Analytics Manager, you will be the analytics owner. You will also be the advisor for one to two GrabFood product problem spaces. These problem spaces may include, for example, ordering experience and conversion, merchant discovery and content, delivery reliability and demand shaping, or affordability and promotions. You will work directly with the product manager, designers, engineers and data scientists for that space, most of whom are based in Singapore, and with country teams across the region. This is a senior individual-contributor role. You set the metrics. You design an experiment and read it. You make the ship, iterate or stop recommendation and hold it when the data says so. You decide what to prioritise when several partners need you in the same week. This is a product analytics role, not a machine-learning role: your time goes to metrics, experiments, root-cause analysis and product decisions, not to model building. We base this role in Petaling Jaya and will require you to work onsite. The Critical Tasks You Will Perform You will define the metrics for your problem space: the primary metric at the exact step a feature changes, the leading and lagging indicators around it, and the guardrails that catch the failure modes. You will design and analyse controlled experiments with your product manager: hypothesis, randomisation unit, success metric, sample size and duration, guardrails, and the checks that keep a result honest. You will turn results into a clear ship, iterate or stop recommendation. You will diagnose metric movements systematically. This will involve, locating the movement, decomposing it, cutting it by funnel step, segment, platform, and market. After that, ruling out tracking and data-quality causes. Finally, explaining it why. You will size opportunities and run proactive deep dives into consumer, merchant and driver-partner behaviour that shape the roadmap rather than report on it. You will oversee the data specifications and instrumentation for new features with engineering, so the data exists to measure what you planned to measure. You will build the dashboards and certified metrics that give the product team reliable self-serve visibility. You will build AI-assisted analytics workflows for yourself and the team, validated against raw data and business logic, and share what works. You will improve on experimentation and analytical rigour across the problem spaces you touch, and coach junior analysts as the team grows. What Essential Skills You Will Need At least 4 years in analytics or quantitative roles, with at least 2 years of experience where you owned the metrics for a consumer product, growth, pricing, CRM, or marketing programme. Experience in data analytics is a bonus. It is especially valuable in industries such as food or grocery delivery and e-commerce marketplaces. It is also valuable in ride-hailing and super-apps, e-wallets and digital banking, travel, telco digital products, and consumer FinTech. Fluent SQL on large datasets, and proficient Python or R for analysis. Hands-on experience designing and analysing controlled experiments: A/B tests, holdouts, or well-designed quasi-experiments such as difference-in-differences or synthetic control where randomisation was not possible. You can explain why you chose the design, what could bias it, and how you read a result that is not clean. Sound statistics applied to decisions: hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, sample size and power, multiple comparisons, selection bias and mix shifts. You can explain these in plain language to a product manager, and you know when a method breaks. Precise metric framing: You can define the right metric for a change. This includes specifying its numerator, denominator, and the population it is measured on. Additionally, you can distinguish a feature-engagement metric from a conversion metric. Structured solutioning on ambiguous questions: You lay out the space before you commit to a hypothesis, and you can write the analysis plan before you open a notebook. Manage partner trade-offs: You set priorities across competing asks, say no with reasons, and keep quality on what you ship. You close your own knowledge gaps quickly and act on feedback. Clear communication: you make the finding and the decision clear to product leaders and engineers alike, in writing and live. You use AI tools in your supervised analytics workflow, validating output against raw data and business logic. At least a Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Analytics or another quantitative field. What Would Be Good to Have Experience in food delivery, marketplaces or super-apps across Southeast Asian markets. Experience with an experimentation platform, or having built experiment analysis tooling. Causal inference methods beyond A/B testing. Dashboarding in tools like Tableau, Superset or PowerBI; build data pipelines. Have built a reusable AI workflow, skill or agent that your team adopted. Coach analysts. Our mission: shield Grab ecosystem from evolving fraud and safety threats by turning massive datasets into applicable intelligence. From deploying sequence-based models for payment risk to applying graph algorithms that unmask complex money laundering networks, we operate at intersection of deep learning and platform security. We innovate constantly, researching latest methods to neutralise tactics before they surface. Compile accuracy/performance metrics and statistical analysis to drive model improvement. Implement structured logging, CloudWatch dashboards, and alarms/SNS notifications for service health, error rates, and model degradation.

  • Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks/algorithms (e.g. scikit-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch, TensorFlow).

  • Experience training and operationalizing custom ML models end to end (data prep, training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring).
  • Experience designing and deploying on AWS, hands-on with core services used here: Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, SageMaker, Bedrock, Textract, DynamoDB, S3, ECR, SSM Parameter Store, CloudWatch, VPC/IAM.

Join New Era Technology, where People First is at the heart of everything we do. Guided by our core attributes — putting people first, embracing continuous learning, and thriving through collaboration and inclusion — we nurture our people to deliver exceptional customer service.

If you want to make an impact in a supportive, growth-oriented environment, New Era is the place for you. Apply today and help us shape the future of work—together

🌟 Hiring: DevOps, Digital Engineer | New Era Technology 🌟

Company: New Era Technology – www.neweratech.com
Work location : Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia

Work Type: Full-Time

Contract: 12months(extendable)

🚀 About the Role:

New Era Technology is looking for experienced Devops, Digital Engineer to be deployed at our prestigious client in Malaysia. We are a small but high-impact cloud team managing end-to-end AWS infrastructure. We are looking for a hands-on engineer to join us across three core areas: GenAI project deliver, cloud platform run/build and cloud security operations.

Role Mission

Support security posture monitoring and remediation follow-up across all AWS accounts, contribute to GenAI-enabled application development, and participate in day-to-day cloud platform operations.

Key Responsibilities

Pillar 1 — GenAI Project Development

  1. Contribute to the development and delivery of internal GenAI applications (e.g. AI-powered budget management tools).
  2. Participate in architecture and design discussions for GenAI workloads on AWS.
  3. Support integration of AWS AI/ML services (Bedrock, Lambda, API Gateway, S3) into application workflows.
  4. Work with AI-assisted development tools including VS Code, GitHub Copilot, Kiro.
  5. Write and maintain technical documentation for GenAI features and components.

Pillar 2 — Cloud Security Operations

  1. Monitor security posture daily using Amazon Inspector, AWS Security Hub, AWS WAF, AWS Shield, and Amazon GuardDuty.
  2. Track, prioritize, and follow up on findings with respective application and infrastructure teams.
  3. Produce and deliver security status reports to management.
  4. Help enforce Security Hub controls and compliance baselines across all AWS accounts.

Pillar 3 — Cloud Platform BAU Run and Build

  1. Support day-to-day operations across the AWS stack: RDS, ECS, EKS, EC2, S3, Lambda, API Gateway, CloudWatch, CloudFront, ELB.
  2. Assist with networking operations including Direct Connect and Transit Gateway route table management.
  3. Support CI/CD pipelines and deployments using GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Helm and Terraform.
  4. Contribute to observability and monitoring using CloudWatch, Grafana, Prometheus, and Dynatrace.
  5. Participate in FinOps activities including cost visibility, tagging quality, daily cost reporting to management, and optimization follow-up with teams.
  6. Participate in architecture reviews with a focus on secure, scalable, and cost-aware cloud design.
  7. Write and maintain runbooks, technical documentation, and implementation notes.

Required Qualifications

  1. 4+ years of hands-on AWS experience.
  2. Good AWS fundamentals: IAM, VPC, EC2, S3, Lambda, API Gateway, CloudWatch.
  3. Exposure to cloud security tooling: Inspector, Security Hub, WAF, Shield, GuardDuty, or equivalent.
  4. Familiarity with FinOps
  5. Comfortable working with Linux CLI and basic system administration.
  6. Familiarity with Configuration as Code (Terraform), CI/CD concepts; GitHub Actions experience is a plus.
  7. Good communication skills with the ability to follow up across teams and report to management.
  8. Strong ownership mindset and collaborative approach.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Experience with ECS, EKS, ArgoCD, and Helm.
  2. Multi-account AWS exposure: Control Tower, IAM Identity Center.
  3. Experience with observability tooling: Grafana, Prometheus, Dynatrace.
  4. Exposure to GenAI workloads.
  5. Experience with FinOps tooling: Cost Explorer, Budgets, CUR, Savings Plans.
  6. Development experience, preferably with Node.js or Python.
  7. Comfortable with AI-assisted development tools: VS Code, GitHub Copilot, Kiro.

👤 Preferred Candidate:

  • Nationality: Malaysians
  • Availability: Candidates who can join immediate to 60days notice.

Please Send your updated resume to Sravani.Karri@neweratech.com
